comparisonCases.question: Finkel Ur: you have one piece on 6 and six at home; your opponent has one on safe rosette 8 and six at home. You roll 2. List your legal moves.
comparisonCases.expectedAnswer: Only enter a home piece at path index 2. Advancing 6 to 8 is illegal because the opponent occupies the safe central rosette.

comparisonCases.question: Backgammon (your pip indices): you have 1 on bar 25 and 14 off; opponent has 2 on your 19-point and 13 off. Roll 6 and 3. List your legal turn.
comparisonCases.expectedAnswer: Enter 25 to 22 with the 3, then move 22 to 16 with the 6. Entry to 19 with the 6 is blocked.
